heading.title: Special Provisions Relating to State Transport Undertakings

article.title: Disposal of article found in vehicles.
article.content: Where any article found in any transport vehicle operated by the State transport undertaking is not claimed by its owner within the prescribed period, the State transport undertaking may sell the article in the prescribed manner and the sale proceeds thereof, after deducting the costs incidental to sale, shall be paid to the owner on demand.
article.html:
106Disposal of article found in vehicles.

Section 106 · Chapter VI · page 72 of the Act

Where any article found in any transport vehicle operated by the State transport undertaking is not claimed by its owner within the prescribed period, the State transport undertaking may sell the article in the prescribed manner and the sale proceeds thereof, after deducting the costs incidental to sale, shall be paid to the owner on demand.
